# Vidya Orbit

> Vidya Orbit — Tuition and coaching centre management software in Kerala

Tuition and coaching centre management software for Kerala: attendance, fees, receipts and report cards. Built in Valanchery, Malappuram. Pay in the app with UPI or cards.

Vidya Orbit is a SaaS product for coaching centres and tuition centres in Kerala. The founder, Aryanand, is based in Valanchery, Kerala (Malappuram district). After a WhatsApp or phone call he imports the centre's students from Excel or CSV, sets up batches and fees, adds staff, and gives a 30-minute training.

The product screens are in English. The student import template includes Malayalam instructions. Setup help is on WhatsApp from Valanchery.

## Who it is for

Owners of coaching centres, tuition centres, and small institutes who currently track students, attendance and fees in notebooks, WhatsApp chats, or spreadsheets.

## Features

- Students and batches (name, parent/guardian phone, fee total, due date)
- Attendance on a phone: present / late / absent, including All present
- Fee tracking: paid, pending, overdue; cash, UPI or bank
- Numbered receipts with the centre name; print or save as PDF, then send on WhatsApp yourself
- Monthly report cards and today's absentee alerts as WhatsApp drafts the centre sends
- Staff invites with a join link (owner chooses whether staff can see fees)
- Excel / CSV import (.xlsx, .xls, .csv) — pasting cells is not supported
- Export students, batches, dues and payments as Excel or CSV
- Analytics dashboard on Spark and above

VidyaOrbit prepares a WhatsApp fee reminder with the centre UPI link. The owner sends an assisted wa.me draft from the centre's own phone, and the parent pays the centre directly. The app does not message parents by itself. Parents install nothing.

## Pricing (INR)

Prices below are the public plans in the product. Pay in the app on the Plan page with UPI or cards through Razorpay.

- Free: ₹0/month — Up to 25 students. Small centres, self-serve.
- Spark: ₹499/month or ₹4,990/year — Up to 50 students. 2 months free.
- Orbit: ₹999/month or ₹9,990/year — Up to 150 students. 2 months free.
- Centre: ₹1,499/month or ₹14,990/year — Up to 400 students. First monthly invoice includes ₹2,000 done for you setup (waived on yearly). 2 months free · setup waived.
- Campus: ₹2,499/month or ₹24,990/year — 400+ students. First monthly invoice includes ₹3,000 done for you setup (waived on yearly). 2 months free · setup waived.
